description: Five deterministic V1 control-plane scenarios using the accepted runtime components and scripted providers. No live model, benchmark-only scheduler, or privileged demo runtime is used.

scenarios.description: Developer edits within scope, deterministic verification passes, Reviewer passes, and no repair is required.
Protected test tampering is detected as a typed SCOPE_VIOLATION.
Hard checks pass, semantic Reviewer requests changes, targeted repair re-verifies, and the run succeeds.
Invalid Planner structure enters bounded schema repair before a valid TaskContract is accepted.
Two tasks run concurrently in isolated worktrees, commit independently, enter the topological merge queue, and produce a Git conflict that is structurally classified.
